info.title: Harvester of Sorrow API
info.description:
REST API for Harvester of Sorrow — a video downloader supporting VixSrc and RaiPlay sources and direct links (Mega, HTTP).

**Key features:**
- Search movies and TV shows across multiple sources
- Download from a link: Mega files and folders, direct HTTP files
- Queue, monitor, cancel and retry downloads
- Real-time progress updates via Server-Sent Events
- TV show library scanning and automatic episode monitoring

**Notes:**
- No authentication is required
- VixSrc availability checks use the Italian (`it`) catalogue, then ask VixSrc directly for titles not in it
- Live updates: `GET /api/v1/events` (`text/event-stream`)
- Errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`

put.summary: Change a monitored show's source match

post.summary: Check that the external tools are installed
post.description: ffmpeg (HLS downloads), 7zip and unrar (unpacking archives from links).
Queues episodes newer than the latest one on disk. Returns how many were queued.
Expands shows and seasons server-side and returns every task created.

delete.description: Removes completed, failed, cancelled and not-found tasks. Files on disk are kept.

post.description: Allowed for FAILED and CANCELLED tasks.

409.description: Task is not failed or cancelled

post.description: Allowed in any non-terminal state, including QUEUED.

post.summary: Episodes really available on the source
post.description: VixSrc: TMDB episodes filtered by the VixSrc catalogue (falls back to TMDB when the catalogue is unavailable). RaiPlay: the program's episode listings. Each episode has its own sourceRef.

get.summary: Runtime information and free disk space of the download paths
Enabled sources, their languages, and download defaults

get.description: Change via environment variables and restart.
Searches every enabled source in parallel. VixSrc results are filtered by real availability.

Every folder under DOWNLOAD_TV_SHOWS_PATH plus monitored shows whose folder is gone, with on-disk season/episode counts, monitoring config and TMDB airing status (folders without a TMDB id are matched by name).

Named events, each `data` is JSON:
- `snapshot`: array of all tasks, sent first on every (re)connect
- `task.created`, `task.updated`, `task.removed`: one full task
A `:heartbeat` comment is sent about every 15 s. Updates are throttled to ~4/s per task;
terminal states are sent immediately. Clients should replace their state on `snapshot`
and upsert/delete by id on the others.

post.description: Lists the file(s) behind the link without downloading, guesses title/year/episode from the names and suggests TMDB matches. The provider is detected from the URL unless `provider` is given. Also starts the provider's preparation (e.g. Mega's proxy warm-up) in the background.
One task per item. Items must come from POST /links/resolve of the same link; the library path is built from the confirmed title/year (and season/episode for TV).

get.summary: Search TMDB for the title of a link

post.summary: Inspect several links as one group
post.description: Like POST /links/resolve for a list of links of the same provider (e.g. XDCC packs picked from a search), returned as one folder-like resolution.

400.description: Unsupported links, or links of different providers

get.summary: Whether XDCC search is available, per source

get.description: Queries every source at once, merges the bots offering the same file, folds multi-part archives, and groups releases by title (most relevant first, best quality first, TMDB poster for the top titles). Pass a release's `urls` to POST /links/resolve-batch, then queue with POST /links/downloads.

post.summary: Audio, subtitles and qualities a title really has
post.description: Reads the title's playlist on the source without downloading. For a show, the first episode the source has is checked; later episodes may differ. `known=false` when the source can't tell.

get.summary: The current user's watchlist, most recently saved first

get.description: From TMDB: an official trailer in the default language when there is one, else in English or another language, else a teaser. `url` is null when TMDB has none.

delete.summary: Remove a title from the watchlist

post.summary: Mark a title that became available as seen
post.description: Drops its "now available" badge; the UI calls it when the user opens the title.

post.summary: Look for the current user's waiting titles now
post.description: Runs the daily check (VixSrc, RaiPlay, XDCC) for this user's titles no source had when they were saved. Can take a while: XDCC is searched by each name. Returns the watchlist.

get.description: Used only on networks where a channel needs a registered nick. Saved in Settings, else taken from the XDCC_IRC_* variables.

put.description: Used from the next login on; leave the password empty to keep it.

delete.summary: Remove the registered IRC nick saved in Settings

post.summary: Confirm the nick with the code NickServ e-mailed
post.description: Connects to the network if needed and sends NickServ CONFIRM <code>.

get.summary: IRC networks: connected now, or where a channel needed the registered nick

delete.summary: Forget that a network needs the registered nick

MonitoredShowRequest.description: Create or update a monitored show. `directoryName` is ignored on update.

MonitoredShowDto.description: A show directory linked to a source for automatic new-episode downloads

ToolCheckDto.description: Result of probing an external tool

quality.description: best, worst or a height such as 1080, 720, 480; empty = server default

subtitleLanguages.description: Subtitle languages; omitted = same as `languages`, empty = no subtitles

SubTaskDto.description: One track (video, audio or subtitle) of a download task

statusMessage.description: What a queued or downloading task is waiting for (a link provider warming up, an XDCC bot queue, ...)

TaskDto.description: A download task with its tracks

EpisodesRequest.description: Which show (and optionally which season) to list episodes for

EpisodeDto.description: An episode that is really available on the source

DiskDto.description: Disk usage of a configured download path

languages.description: Audio languages the source serves; empty = no restriction

tmdbApiKeyMasked.description: Masked TMDB key, e.g. `••••••••3f9a`; null when unset

monitoringSchedule.description: When the automatic check runs, in words

monitoringLanguageWaitDays.description: Days a new episode waits for audio in the default language

SettingsDto.description: Read-only configuration (change via environment variables and restart)

localTitle.description: Title in the configured download language, when it differs (TMDB)

externalUrl.description: Public page of the title (TMDB or RaiPlay)

sourceRef.description: Opaque source reference; pass back unchanged to /content/episodes and /downloads

releaseDate.description: Release date (films) or first air date (shows), from TMDB

available.description: False for a title no source serves yet (e.g. still in cinemas): it can be saved to the watchlist but not downloaded. Missing means true (results saved before this field existed).

SeasonDto.description: A season of a TV show as known at search time

directoryExists.description: False when a monitored show's folder is gone

completed.description: True when TMDB reports the show as Ended or Canceled. Completed monitored shows are skipped by scheduled checks.

showStatus.description: TMDB show status (e.g. "Returning Series", "Ended"); null when unknown (TMDB not configured or no match)

monitored.description: Null when the folder is not monitored

LibraryEntryDto.description: A show folder on disk, with its monitoring config if any

provider.description: Provider id to use instead of detecting it from the URL

size.description: Bytes; all parts together for multi-part archives

folders.description: Folders above the file inside a shared folder

parts.description: Volumes of a multi-part archive (first one included); empty otherwise; pass back when queueing

LinkFileDto.description: One downloadable file of a link (a multi-part archive counts as one, with its parts)

LinkGuessDto.description: What a file name looks like (a guess to confirm)

truncated.description: Files left out of a very large folder

guess.description: Guess for the link as a whole (folder name, or the single file)

matches.description: TMDB candidates for the guess, best first; empty when TMDB is not configured

LinkResolutionDto.description: What a link points to, with a guess of what it is and TMDB candidates

TmdbMatchDto.description: A TMDB title a link may be

tmdbId.description: Confirmed TMDB match; omit for a manual title

season.description: TV: required, except for archives (season packs), where it is the fallback season

episode.description: TV: required, except for archives (episodes are read from the names inside)

episodeName.description: Filled from TMDB when omitted and tmdbId is set

LinkDownloadItem.description: One file and what it is

LinkDownloadRequest.description: Queue files of a resolved link, each with the identity the user confirmed

LinkProviderDto.description: A link download provider and whether it can start downloads now

LinkPartDto.description: One volume of a multi-part archive

ResolveLinksRequest.description: Several links of one provider to queue together (e.g. XDCC packs picked from a search)

name.description: Name shown for the group, e.g. the search words

XdccStatusDto.description: Whether XDCC search can run, per source

available.description: At least one source can search

XdccSearchDto.description: XDCC search results: titles, each with its releases (bots merged)

XdccSourceDto.description: One XDCC search source and how it did

message.description: Detail: why it is unavailable, or what it found

XdccQualityDto.description: Quality tags read from a release name

XdccReleaseDto.description: One file (or multi-part archive) and every bot offering it

label.description: File name, or archive set name

urls.description: Links to pass to POST /links/resolve-batch: one, or one per archive volume

complete.description: False when archive volumes are missing

XdccTitleDto.description: Releases of one title, best first

relevance.description: 3: starts with the search words, 2: contains them in order, 1: contains them all, 0: matched elsewhere

MediaInfoRequest.description: Which title to describe; for a show, the first episode the source has is checked

MediaInfoDto.description: Audio, subtitles and qualities a title really has (for a show: its first episode)

known.description: Whether the source could describe the title; false = unknown, offer the source's full language list

WatchlistRequest.description: Save a title for later. Saving one that is already there refreshes its details (fields left empty keep their saved value) and keeps the date it was saved.

streams.description: Streaming search results of the title (may be empty for XDCC-only titles)

releaseDate.description: Release date (films) or first air date (shows)

names.description: Other names of the title (original, Italian) the daily check looks it up by

available.description: Whether a source serves the title now. False saves it as waiting: HoS checks every day and flags it when it can be downloaded. Missing means true.

titleKey.description: Title key as the search page builds it

streams.description: Streaming search results of the title, as saved; pass each to the download form

waiting.description: Saved before any source had it; checked every day

availableSince.description: When the daily check found it can be downloaded

availableSources.description: Where the daily check found it: VIXSRC, RAIPLAY, XDCC

availableQuery.description: What to search to find it (the name that found it)

newlyAvailable.description: Became available and the user has not opened it since

url.description: YouTube link; null when TMDB has no trailer

language.description: Language of the trailer, two-letter code

password.description: Empty or omitted: keep the current password

IrcIdentityDto.description: The registered IRC nick used where an XDCC channel needs one. The password is never returned.

email.description: Used only to register the nick

autoRegister.description: Register the nick where it is not registered yet

origin.description: SETTINGS (saved here), ENVIRONMENT (XDCC_IRC_* variables) or NONE

IrcConfirmRequest.description: The code NickServ e-mailed after registering the nick

IrcNetworkDto.description: An IRC network: connected now, or remembered because a channel there needed the registered nick

needsAccount.description: A channel here needs the registered nick
